verdict.rationale: New Relic's main API, NerdGraph, is a GraphQL API with an API explorer. A typed GraphQL schema is a plausible machine-readable equivalent to OpenAPI, but the evidence never says the schema can be downloaded or introspected. Probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. missing for 10: documented downloadable OpenAPI or GraphQL schema file, explicit introspection/schema-export docs, machine-readable specs for the REST APIs, independent corroboration.
